title: kernscope kernel report
description: Structured report emitted by the kernscope tools (analyzer, profiler, ...): a kernel identity, a flat machine-readable numeric metrics map, the main occupancy limiter, and warning/suggestion findings. Every measured quantity is a machine-readable field; renderers never emit prose-only reports. Evidence values are strings so numeric fields stay simple and machine-readable. The special evidence key "text" carries the one-line human summary used by the text renderer.

schema_version.description: Version of this report envelope (not the JSON Schema draft).

report_type.description: Tool that produced the report, e.g. static_analyzer or profiler.

name.description: Kernel identity, e.g. fused_attention.ptx or layernorm_fused.

metrics.description: Flat numeric metrics (occupancy, registers_per_thread, ...). No prose allowed here: every metric is a machine-readable number.

limiter.description: Main occupancy limiter as a human string, e.g. "112 registers/thread" (the numeric register count lives in metrics.registers_per_thread).

id.description: Stable machine-readable finding identifier, e.g. bank_conflict.

severity.description: Severity bucket, e.g. warning or suggestion.

evidence.description: Key/value evidence for the finding. The special key "text" is the one-line human summary used by the text renderer; all other keys are machine-readable fields.
